text: ２たい２の　しょうぶです　たたかえる　ポケモンが　２たい　いじょう　いないと　しょうぶ　できません！

structure.jp: たたかえる　ポケモンが
２たい　いじょう　いないと
structure.en: unless there are two or more

structure.jp: しょうぶ　できません！

patterns.name: 〜ないと
patterns.explanation: と after a 'not' verb means 'if not' or 'unless', and what follows is what always happens then. ２たい　いじょう　いないと = 'unless there are two or more'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: Changing the verb ending to える says that someone is able to do it. たたかえる　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that can fight'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.span: たたかえる　ポケモン
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing tells you which kind of thing it is. たたかえる　ポケモン = 'Pokémon that can fight'.
